obligations.statement: The stand must have a configuration that is narrow and compact when folded.
derivation_premises: The user observes that 'the whole thing becomes narrow and compact when I put it away' and 'fold back down to the same compact shape it started in'.

obligations.statement: All components must remain attached to the stand during folding and unfolding.
derivation_premises: The user says 'Everything should stay attached while it is folded', 'I do not want to take anything off to fold it, or loose pieces to look after', 'Nothing should come apart or fall off while I am opening it', and 'with all normal parts remaining attached'.

obligations.statement: The stand must be openable by hand without tools, motor, or other equipment.
derivation_premises: The user says 'I should be able to open it by hand', 'I should not need tools, a motor, or any other equipment' and 'I should not need tools, a motor, or any other equipment to do it'.

obligations.statement: The opening sequence must be guided and clear, with each step making sense to the user.
derivation_premises: The user says 'following a sequence that makes sense as I go'.

obligations.statement: When open, the legs must spread in different directions to provide a stable footprint on the desk.
derivation_premises: The user says 'The three legs should end up spread apart in different directions so they give the stand a usable footprint on the desk.' and 'hold a small object'.

obligations.statement: The stand must remain stable and maintain its open configuration without user support.
derivation_premises: The user says 'Once it is open, it needs to stay open on its own', 'I should not have to hold the legs while I use it', 'they should not be able to fold back, twist aside, or come off', and 'Nothing should turn on its own, shift out of place, or move in some other direction I was not expecting.'

obligations.statement: The stand must require a deliberate action to fold it from the open configuration.
derivation_premises: The user says 'Before it can be folded again I want to have to do something deliberate.'

obligations.statement: The stand must fold back to the same compact shape as originally, repeatably.
derivation_premises: The user says 'After that deliberate release, it should fold back down to the same compact shape it started in.' and 'The opening and folding sequence should be repeatable.'

obligations.statement: The stand must be capable of holding a small object on the desk.
derivation_premises: The user says 'It is meant to hold a small object on my desk while I am working.'

obligations.statement: The stand must be assemblable in a sensible order without requiring removal of parts.
derivation_premises: The user says 'It should also be something that can genuinely be built as a product and put together in a sensible order' and 'with all normal parts remaining attached'.

obligations.statement: The stand must have no unintended motion, such as turning, shifting, or moving in unexpected directions.
derivation_premises: The user says 'Nothing should turn on its own, shift out of place, or move in some other direction I was not expecting.'

obligations.statement: The stand must equally support the intended small object without excessive deflection or instability, though the load is unspecified.
derivation_premises: The user's requirement to 'hold a small object' implies the stand must carry its weight; ambiguity AMB-0001 leaves the load magnitude undefined.

candidates.summary: A tripod stand using a compliant flexure hub that allows folding and provides a detent-like hold, molded as one piece.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Requires deflection and snap force analysis, which is not available.

evidence_route_verdict.note: Revolute joints and a guide collar provide the necessary motion.
